global_window.note: Global window computed from 100 LR slices

radiometric.note: From rock-only pixels with global windowing (preserves radiometry)

blur.bandwidth_90_range_note: Degenerate range expected for heavily low-pass real LR data where 90% cumulative energy is reached near DC.

noise.poisson_peak_range_note: Superseded - training used recalibrated range [8263, 15345] derived from HP residual sweep.
noise.gaussian_sigma_note: Gaussian noise disabled in final training. Poisson-only at recalibrated peak.

bias_field.training_note: Observed LR bias amplitudes were not used directly. Final training applies a multiplicative B-spline bias field with amplitude capped at 0.006 (0.5 × σ_t) to preserve realistic low-frequency shading without overwhelming rock-phase contrast.

metadata.synthetic_lr_pixel_spacing_note: Derived from 4x downscale of HR (4 x 4.73 um). Not a physical acquisition voxel size.
metadata.philosophy: Global window + rock-only radiometry + fixed bandwidth
